title: Scaling behaviour of the deconfinement temperature for SU(2) pure gauge theory at finite temperature

reference.unstructured: DESY preprints 83/016, 83/026.

items.publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
items.abstract:
<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
          </jats:title>
          <jats:p>I study the localisation properties of low Dirac eigenmodes in 2+1 dimensional SU(3) pure gauge theory, both in the low-temperature, confined and chirally-broken phase and in the high-temperature, deconfined and chirally-restored phase, by means of numerical lattice simulations. While these modes are delocalised at low temperature, they become localised at high temperature, up to a critical point in the Dirac spectrum where a BKTtype Anderson transition takes place. All results point to localisation appearing at the deconfinement temperature, and support previous expectations about the close relation between deconfinement, chiral symmetry breaking, and localisation.</jats:p>
title: Localisation in 2+1 dimensional SU(3) pure gauge theory at finite temperature
